body_markdown:
I really like the Daily Briefing feature! However, it would be great if the language of the AI-generated summaries matched the selected system language.


My primary language is German. Around 70% of my subscribed feeds are in German, while the remaining 30% are in English. For the Daily Briefing, I use the “Bullet Points” writing style.


Currently, the summaries are rarely generated in German and are mostly written entirely in English. It seems that the language of the source articles influences the language chosen for the entire briefing. As a result, even German-language articles are frequently summarised in English.


**My suggestion:** The Daily Briefing should always be generated in the selected system language, regardless of the language of the original articles. Alternatively, having a separate language setting specifically for the Daily Briefing would be ideal.


This would allow users to follow international sources while still enjoying a consistent briefing in their preferred language.
